input:
You are rook_h1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 51. the team planned Rg7+ (rook_h1), but rook_h1 (amnesia) sent Rh2 instead, and that move was played, no worse than the plan.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 11. the team planned d4 (pawn_d2), but knight_g1 (greed) sent Nxe5 instead, and that move was played, costing 232 centipawns.
- On move 30. the team planned Ba3 (bishop_c1), but bishop_c1 (amnesia) sent Bb2 instead, and that move was played, costing 8 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Only send your piece's move if it is the move the team agreed on in chat for this turn; if your piece is not the chosen piece, stay silent even when a capture looks tempting or your piece is attacked, and if you are the chosen piece, send exactly the agreed move and no other.
- Before sending any move, re-read the chat and confirm the agreed move is for your own piece and send exactly that move; if you are not the chosen piece stay silent even if you are attacked or a capture looks good, and if you are the chosen piece send only the agreed move, not a similar one.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending, write your piece's name and the exact move (e.g. 'rook_h1: Rg7+') in chat and confirm it matches the plan word for word; if you are not the named piece, or the move differs from the plan in any way, do not send.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
